hooks.name: Format on Save
hooks.description: Global replacement for the 17 duplicated per-agent inline postToolUse hooks; auto-formats a file right after fs_write using the existing fail-closed formatter script (ruff/prettier/shfmt/swiftformat by extension). Not synced to kiro-cli --cloud sandboxes since hooks-bin/ is outside Configuration Sync's 7 synced folders, so it fails closed (no-op) there and never errors.
